methods.name: PerformClick
methods.description: Generates a Click event for the button, as if the user had clicked it.
methods.expectedEffect: The code in the button's Click handler runs immediately.

methods.name: AppendText
methods.description: Adds text to the end of the current text without replacing it.
methods.expectedEffect: The new line appears at the end of the box. Faster than using += on Text.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all text from the control.
methods.expectedEffect: The box becomes empty.

methods.name: SelectAll
methods.description: Selects all the text in the control.
methods.expectedEffect: All text is highlighted, so typing replaces it.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Selects a range of characters.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Index of the first character to select (0-based).

methods.expectedEffect: The first five characters are highlighted.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies the selected text to the Clipboard.
methods.expectedEffect: The selection is placed on the Clipboard.

methods.name: Paste
methods.description: Replaces the selection with the text on the Clipboard.
methods.expectedEffect: The Clipboard text is inserted at the caret.

methods.name: Undo
methods.description: Undoes the last edit made by the user.
methods.expectedEffect: The previous text is restored.

methods.name: LoadFile
methods.description: Loads a file (RTF or plain text) into the control.

parameters.name: fileType
parameters.description: RichText, PlainText, UnicodePlainText and so on.

methods.expectedEffect: The file content, including formatting, appears in the control. Throws if the file is missing or not valid.

methods.name: SaveFile
methods.description: Saves the content of the control to a file.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Full path of the file to create.

methods.expectedEffect: A file with the formatted text is written.

methods.name: Find
methods.returnDescription: The index of the first match, or -1 if the text was not found.
methods.description: Searches the text and selects the first match.
methods.example:
int index = rtbNotes.Find("error");
if (index < 0) MessageBox.Show("Not found.");
methods.expectedEffect: The match is highlighted when found.

methods.name: AppendText
methods.description: Adds text to the end of the content.
methods.expectedEffect: The text is appended using the current selection formatting.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all content.
methods.expectedEffect: The control is empty.

methods.name: ValidateText
methods.returnDescription: The converted value, or null if the text could not be converted to ValidatingType.
methods.description: Converts the text to the type set in ValidatingType.
methods.expectedEffect: Returns a DateTime if the text is a valid date; otherwise null.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all entered characters, leaving the mask.
methods.expectedEffect: Only the mask with prompt characters remains.

methods.name: SelectAll
methods.description: Selects all text in the control.
methods.expectedEffect: The whole mask is highlighted.

methods.name: PerformClick
methods.description: Generates a Click event for the radio button, selecting it.
methods.expectedEffect: The radio button becomes selected and its Click handler runs.

methods.name: Items.Add
methods.returnDescription: The index of the new item.
methods.description: Adds an item to the end of the list.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: The object to add. Its ToString() text is shown.

methods.expectedEffect: "Canada" appears at the end of the drop-down list.

methods.name: Items.AddRange
methods.description: Adds several items at once.
methods.expectedEffect: All three items are added; faster than adding them one by one.

methods.name: FindStringExact
methods.returnDescription: The index of the item that matches exactly, or -1 (ListBox.NoMatches).
methods.description: Finds the first item whose text exactly matches (ignoring case).
methods.expectedEffect: "France" becomes the selected item if it exists.

methods.name: BeginUpdate
methods.description: Stops the control from repainting while you change many items. Always pair with EndUpdate().
methods.expectedEffect: No flicker while the list is changed.

methods.name: EndUpdate
methods.description: Resumes painting after BeginUpdate().
methods.expectedEffect: The control repaints once with all changes.

methods.name: Items.Add
methods.returnDescription: The index of the new item.
methods.description: Adds an item to the end of the list.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: The object to add. Its ToString() text is shown.

methods.expectedEffect: "Milk" appears at the bottom of the list.

methods.name: ClearSelected
methods.description: Deselects all items.
methods.expectedEffect: No item is highlighted; SelectedIndex becomes -1.

methods.name: SetSelected
methods.description: Selects or deselects an item.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: true to select, false to deselect.

methods.expectedEffect: The first item is highlighted.

methods.name: GetSelected
methods.returnDescription: true if the item is selected.
methods.description: Tells whether an item is selected.
methods.expectedEffect: Returns true when the first item is selected.

methods.name: FindString
methods.returnDescription: The index of the first item that starts with the text, or -1.
methods.description: Finds the first item that starts with the given text (ignoring case).

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: The beginning of the text to look for.

methods.expectedEffect: Returns the index of "Milk" if present.

methods.name: BeginUpdate
methods.description: Suspends painting while you add many items. Pair with EndUpdate().
methods.expectedEffect: No flicker while items are added.

methods.name: Items.Add
methods.returnDescription: The index of the new item.
methods.description: Adds an item and sets whether it starts checked.

parameters.name: isChecked
parameters.description: true to add it already ticked.

methods.expectedEffect: "E-mail" appears with its box ticked.

methods.name: SetItemChecked
methods.description: Ticks or clears the box of an item.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: true to tick, false to clear.

methods.expectedEffect: The third item becomes ticked.

methods.name: GetItemChecked
methods.returnDescription: true if the item is ticked.
methods.description: Tells whether an item is ticked.
methods.expectedEffect: Returns true when the first item is ticked.

methods.name: GetItemCheckState
methods.description: Gets the exact check state of an item.
methods.expectedEffect: Returns the three-state value of the second item.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads an image from a file path or URL and displays it. Blocks until the image is loaded.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A file path or web address.

methods.expectedEffect: The picture is shown. Throws if it cannot be loaded.

methods.name: LoadAsync
methods.description: Starts loading an image in the background. LoadCompleted is raised at the end.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A file path or web address.

methods.expectedEffect: The window stays responsive while the image downloads.

methods.name: CancelAsync
methods.description: Cancels a LoadAsync operation that is still running.
methods.expectedEffect: LoadCompleted is raised with Cancelled = true.

methods.name: SetDate
methods.description: Selects a single date and shows its month.
methods.expectedEffect: Today is selected.

methods.name: SetSelectionRange
methods.description: Selects a range of dates.
methods.expectedEffect: Four days are highlighted (the range must not exceed MaxSelectionCount).

methods.name: AddBoldedDate
methods.description: Marks a date in bold. Call UpdateBoldedDates() afterwards.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date to show in bold.

methods.expectedEffect: December 25 is drawn in bold.

methods.name: RemoveAllBoldedDates
methods.description: Removes the bold formatting from all dates.
methods.expectedEffect: No dates are bold.

methods.name: UpdateBoldedDates
methods.description: Redraws the calendar after the bolded dates were changed.
methods.expectedEffect: Changes to the bolded dates become visible.

methods.name: UpButton
methods.description: Increases the value by Increment, as if the up arrow was clicked.
methods.expectedEffect: Value increases (up to Maximum).

methods.name: DownButton
methods.description: Decreases the value by Increment, as if the down arrow was clicked.
methods.expectedEffect: Value decreases (down to Minimum).

methods.name: PerformStep
methods.description: Advances the bar by the amount in the Step property.
methods.expectedEffect: Value increases by 10.

methods.name: Increment
methods.description: Advances the bar by the given amount.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The amount to add to Value.

methods.expectedEffect: Value increases by 5 (never above Maximum).

methods.name: SetRange
methods.description: Sets Minimum and Maximum in one call.
methods.expectedEffect: The slider covers 0 to 100.

methods.name: Links.Add
methods.signature: LinkLabel.Link Links.Add(int start, int length, object linkData)
methods.description: Turns part of the text into a link and stores data with it.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Index of the first character of the link.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Number of characters in the link.

parameters.name: linkData
parameters.description: Any object you want to read back in LinkClicked (e.Link.LinkData).

methods.expectedEffect: Only the word "terms" is clickable.

methods.name: SetToolTip
methods.description: Associates a tip text with a control.

parameters.name: control
parameters.description: The control that shows the tip.

methods.expectedEffect: The tip appears when the mouse rests on the button.

methods.name: GetToolTip
methods.returnDescription: The tip text, or an empty string.
methods.description: Reads the tip text of a control.
methods.expectedEffect: Returns the text set with SetToolTip.

methods.name: Show
methods.signature: void Show(string text, IWin32Window window, int duration)
methods.description: Shows a tip immediately for a given time.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: The control to attach the tip to.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: How long to show it, in milliseconds.

methods.expectedEffect: A tip appears next to the button for two seconds.

methods.name: Hide
methods.description: Hides the tip of a control.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: The control whose tip should be hidden.

methods.expectedEffect: The tip disappears.

methods.name: RemoveAll
methods.description: Removes every tip text that was set.
methods.expectedEffect: No control shows a tip any more.

methods.name: SetError
methods.description: Shows an error icon next to the control with a message. An empty string clears the error.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The message, or an empty string to clear it.

methods.expectedEffect: A red icon appears next to the text box; hovering it shows the message.

methods.name: GetError
methods.returnDescription: The current error text, or an empty string.
methods.description: Reads the error message of a control.
methods.expectedEffect: Returns true when the control is currently flagged.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all error icons and settings.
methods.expectedEffect: All icons disappear.

methods.name: SetIconAlignment
methods.description: Chooses on which side of the control the icon appears.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: TopLeft, MiddleRight, BottomLeft and so on.

methods.expectedEffect: The icon moves to the left of the text box.
